The '''Rayter sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==Description==
Located in the Outer Rim, the Rayter sector was surrounded by the [[Koradin sector/Legends|Koradin]] and [[Kriz sector/Legends|Kriz sectors]] on the coreward side and by the [[Tunka sector/Legends|Tunka]] and [[Seitia sector/Legends|Seitia sectors]] on the rimward side.<ref name="EAOC" />

[[Planet/Legends|Planets]] in the sector included [[Karra]], [[Bancar]], [[Dahvil]], [[Najarka]], [[Narg]], [[Pako Ramoon]], [[Salteract]], and [[Shimmer]]. Rayter sector also included the [[Laim system/Legends|Laim system]], which had no planets.

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Rayter sector had a network of [[Subspace relay station/Legends|subspace relay stations]] operated by the [[Rayter Sector Subspace Broadcast Network]] (RSSBN). It had been authorized by the [[Rayter Sector High Advisory Council]] in order to replicate a small part of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic's]] [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]]. It consisted of sixty-four relay space stations and planet-based broadcast centers.<ref name="TA" />

==History==
The sector was home to [[TransGalMeg Industries, Incorporated|TransGalMeg Industries]], with their headquarters located on [[Narg]].<ref name="TA" /> Prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] they supplied the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] with [[Syliure-31 hyperspace docking ring/Legends|hyperspace rings]] for their [[Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|new starfighters]].<ref name="HNN">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|47|jediwatch/13314_1.html|New Jedi Starfighter Unveiled}}</ref>

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Rayter sector was governed by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Nile Owen]]. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Sector fleet/Legends|Sector Fleet]] included the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] the ''[[Impending Doom]]'' and the Imperial cruiser ''[[Kana's Steel]]''. During [[Operation 45RA]], Owen tried to bring the [[Shashay]] over to the side of the Empire, but was foiled by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] agents.<ref name="TA" />

The Alliance itself had no bases in the sector; it operated from [[Berrol's Donn/Legends|Berrol's Donn]]<ref name="TA" /> in the neighboring Kriz sector.<ref name="EAOC" /> The ''[[Worthless Fool]]'', a [[VR-10 Cuirilla-Rayl Xylines-class spacetug|VR-10 ''Cuirilla-Rayl Xylines''-class Spacetug]], was one of its ship available for its operations.<ref name="TA" />

Following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the Rayter sector was among the first sectors to throw off the Empire.<ref name="RECG" />
